<description>
`CoinGrinder` marks its result as completed when it exhausts the search space before reaching `TOTAL_TRIES`, and leaves it incomplete when it stops at the limit. No unit test reads this flag, and the `coin_grinder` and `coin_grinder_is_optimal` fuzz targets only use it to decide whether to assert optimality, so a wrong value would go unnoticed.

This PR checks `GetAlgoCompleted()` in `coin_grinder_tests` for cases that finish below the attempt limit (100,000), and asserts in both fuzz targets that the flag is true below the limit and false once it is reached.

Kills the following mutants:

https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4402
```diff
--- a/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp
@@ -561,7 +561,7 @@ util::Result<SelectionResult> CoinGrinder(std::vector<OutputGroup>& utxo_pool, c
             if (curr_selection.empty()) {
                 // Exhausted search space before running into attempt limit
                 is_done = true;
-                result.SetAlgoCompleted(true);
+                result.SetAlgoCompleted(false);
                 break;
             }
             next_utxo = curr_selection.back() + 1;
```

https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4401
```diff
--- a/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/coinselection.cpp
@@ -539,7 +539,7 @@ util::Result<SelectionResult> CoinGrinder(std::vector<OutputGroup>& utxo_pool, c

         if (curr_try >= TOTAL_TRIES) {
             // Solution is not guaranteed to be optimal if `curr_try` hit TOTAL_TRIES
-            result.SetAlgoCompleted(false);
+            result.SetAlgoCompleted(true);
             break;
         }

```
</description>

| Build | `coin_grinder_tests` | `coin_grinder` (681 inputs) | `coin_grinder_is_optimal` (231 inputs) |

| 4402 (`false` on search exhaustion) | All six new checks fail | Assertion fails at line 125 | Assertion fails at line 202 |(https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/e5ee8a9658888907306feb0af4bfa141ce7eed42/src/wallet/test/fuzz/coinselection.cpp#L202)](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/e5ee8a9658888907306feb0af4bfa141ce7eed42/src/wallet/test/fuzz/coinselection.cpp#L202) |
| 4401 (`true` at the attempt limit) | Pass | Same assertion fails at line 125 | Pass, 231/231 |

Both assertion line numbers refer to `src/wallet/test/fuzz/coinselection.cpp`. I applied the mutations in `src/wallet/coinselection.cpp`.

```sh
cmake -B build_fuzz -DBUILD_FOR_FUZZING=ON
cmake --build build_fuzz
cmake --build build

build/bin/test_bitcoin --run_test=coinselector_tests/coin_grinder_tests
FUZZ=coin_grinder build_fuzz/bin/fuzz ../qa-assets/fuzz_corpora/coin_grinder
FUZZ=coin_grinder_is_optimal build_fuzz/bin/fuzz ../qa-assets/fuzz_corpora/coin_grinder_is_optimal
```

For 4401, `f94e50c75af1ee1fbe07abb16850bcf5dd28775d` was the first input to trigger the assertion in my run. The runner shuffles the corpus. [[Reproducing input](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/qa-assets/blob/9c61fa724af7566eaa9f97ad23c637374ef469ea/fuzz_corpora/coin_grinder/f94e50c75af1ee1fbe07abb16850bcf5dd28775d)](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/qa-assets/blob/9c61fa724af7566eaa9f97ad23c637374ef469ea/fuzz_corpora/coin_grinder/f94e50c75af1ee1fbe07abb16850bcf5dd28775d)

One optional addition would be a unit test alongside `bnb_exhaustion_with_solution_test` in `coinselection_tests.cpp`. I tried 20 groups built with `MakeCoin(COIN + i)` for `i` from 0 to 19, a target of `10 * COIN`, zero change target and `MAX_STANDARD_TX_WEIGHT`. With the PR, CoinGrinder returned enough to cover the target after exactly 100,000 evaluations, with `GetAlgoCompleted()` false. The same test passed with 4402. With 4401, only `BOOST_CHECK(!result->GetAlgoCompleted())` failed.
